title: FlightFX Reveals Behind-the-Scenes Details of Hawker 800XP Development and Future Plans
summary: A substantial new interview with FlightFX CEO Nick Sdoucos was published yesterday by MSFS Addons.
body:
The interview provides several interesting insights into the developer's aircraft-development strategy.

**What's genuinely new?**

![](</assets/Image 2-1.jpg>)

FlightFX explains that its Hawker 800XP was developed largely in secret before its surprise September launch.

The team surveyed a real aircraft in Birmingham, Alabama, collecting measurements, photographs, audio recordings and technical references. Experienced Hawker pilots also helped validate aircraft systems and procedures.

Sdoucos confirms that the Hawker has become a testing ground for development techniques that will influence future FlightFX projects.

[Watch the Launch Trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HMvO60zMpCY&t=2s)

He also reveals that FlightFX intends to experiment with **free aircraft trials through the MSFS Marketplace**, potentially using them to promote existing aircraft following major updates.

However, **no new aircraft, release date or Challenger 350 development milestone was announced**. [MSFS Addons](https://msfsaddons.com/2026/10/25/interview-flightfx-on-its-surprise-hawker-launch-and-betting-on-the-marketplace/)

**Source:** [MSFS Addons — FlightFX CEO Interview, 25 October](https://msfsaddons.com/2026/10/25/interview-flightfx-on-its-surprise-hawker-launch-and-betting-on-the-marketplace/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
